description: Use this when the user wants the finished files (to upload to App Store Connect or the Play Console, or to use elsewhere) of something they saved (asset_id) or something you made in this conversation (handle). The files are made by the appdesigns editor in the user's browser, the same pixels its Export saves: open_url opens it there and makes them (a PNG per screen, and an MP4 for a screen whose loop is on), then get_export with export_id gives a command that downloads them. With asset_id (something the user saved) it needs the user signed in to appdesigns (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves); with handle (a set or design you made in this conversation, not saved yet) it needs no sign-in.

format.description: auto: an MP4 for each screen whose loop is on (an animated listing asset), a PNG for every other screen. png: stills only.

handle.description: Instead of asset_id: the project_handle create_project returned or the design_handle create_design returned, for something you made in this conversation that the user has not saved yet. Needs no sign-in.

name: export_asset
title: Export an asset's files
